definitions.explanation: Three children born to the same mother at one birth.
A young child of about three. This older sense survives mainly in the proverb below.

examples.japanese: {三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。

examples.english: That household has a hard time raising triplets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なれば→なる：01970_naru⟧なおさらだ。
examples.english: Raising twins is hard enough, so with triplets it is even more so.

examples.japanese: {三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧。
examples.english: The soul of a three-year-old lasts until a hundred. (A child's nature stays for life.)

examples.japanese: {三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that one's character at age three does not change even in adulthood.

examples.japanese: 「{三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ことわざ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性質|せいしつ}→性質：01638_seishitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧だ。
examples.english: The proverb "the soul of a three-year-old lasts until a hundred" means that one's early nature continues for life.

notes:
Compound of {三|み}つ (three) + ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child), with the こ voicing to ご. The everyday meaning is "triplets."

The older sense "three-year-old child" survives chiefly in the proverb {三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (a person's nature in early childhood remains for life).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{産|う}む→産む：01899_umu⟧: to give birth to triplets
- {三|み}つ{子|ご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧: triplet siblings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧: twins — two children born together
- ⟦{四|よ}つ{子|ご}→四つ子：28217_yotsugo⟧: quadruplets — the same pattern with four
